reference_sql:
SELECT pr.promo_code, COUNT(p.product_id) AS n_sonora_products
FROM promotions pr
LEFT JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id AND p.brand = 'Sonora'
WHERE pr.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY pr.promo_code
alternatives: SELECT pr.promo_code, SUM(CASE WHEN p.brand = 'Sonora' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_sonora_products FROM promotions pr LEFT JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id WHERE pr.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1

SELECT pr.promo_code, COUNT(p.product_id) AS n_sonora_products FROM products p JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id AND p.brand = 'Sonora' RIGHT JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = pp.promo_id WHERE pr.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY pr.promo_code

solver.query:
SELECT pr.promo_code, COUNT(sp.product_id) AS n_sonora_products
FROM promotions pr
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT pp.promo_id, pp.product_id
  FROM promotion_products pp
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id
  WHERE p.brand = 'Sonora'
) sp ON sp.promo_id = pr.promo_id
WHERE pr.start_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND pr.start_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY pr.promo_id, pr.promo_code
